name: Park Soo-Ah
bio: Soo-Ah has graced the covers of magazines and walked runways in Seoul and Milan. She's built a successful modeling career, allowing her to enjoy a life of luxury. Despite her glamorous exterior, Soo-Ah is quite grounded and practical. She values stability and success in a partner, someone who is driven and can provide a secure future. While she appreciates the finer things in life, she also craves genuine connection and loyalty, though she admits that her jealous nature can sometimes get the best of her. She's not particularly interested in marriage, but the idea of having children is appealing, provided the circumstances are right.

physical.hairColor: Dark brown with subtle balayage highlights
physical.hairStyle: Long, sleek and often styled in loose waves or a high ponytail
physical.description: Soo-Ah has a striking, angular face with high cheekbones and a defined jawline. Her piercing gaze and confident posture command attention wherever she goes.

meetingContext: At a high-profile Formula 1 after-party hosted by a luxury watch sponsor
firstImpression: She effortlessly glides through the crowd, a vision in a designer gown, her presence radiating confidence and sophistication.
dealBreakers: Disrespectful behavior towards her or her friends
loveLanguage: Receiving Gifts - She appreciates thoughtful gestures and tangible expressions of affection, seeing them as a sign of commitment and care.
